name: Yamanobe Shoukei
source:
Homura's father. He's an archaeologist and the leader of his team. He forgot the key which open the door he wanted in the mansion so called his son to bring it to him.

Pipe/Hammer: he can break some walls if he has the hammer.

[spoiler]In the true ending he reveals he's Yuki's twin brother (Ayakouji Homura) but she didn't believe him.[/spoiler]
